evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As LLMs are increasingly asked questions about a user's personal experiences, retrieval must distinguish memories by time, place, person, and event.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across three standard embedding models evaluated on LongMemEval, ATM-Bench, and LoCoMo, Axis-LoRA improves 4-benchmark mean R@10 by $+1.28$ to $+1.56$~pp while training only a small fraction of the base parameters on a small axis-counterfactual training set.
